description: Pipeworx original random tables: roll one or more entries from a table YOU supply — bring your own weighted list of { text, weight? } and get back a reproducible weighted draw. Entries may contain {{table:<id>}} references to Pipeworx's BUILT-IN random tables (e.g. "{{table:npc_personality}}"), resolved recursively (up to 6 levels deep). Optional seed makes the roll reproducible; the seed used is always returned. No session support for custom tables — use roll_table for session-tracked built-in tables.

entries.description: Your table: a non-empty array of { text: string, weight?: number > 0 (default 1) }. Up to 500 entries.

text.description: The entry text; may embed {{table:<built-in id>}} references.

seed.description: Optional seed for a reproducible roll. Omit for fresh randomness; the seed actually used is always returned.

name: roll_custom_table
title: Roll Custom Table
